descriptionChirho: Hifil and Pual/Poal: to strike root, become firmly established or planted (Isa 27:6; Job 5:3; Ps 80:9; Jer 12:2; Isa 40:24)

labelChirho: to uproot, pull out by the roots
descriptionChirho: Piel active: to tear out by the roots, exterminate, destroy utterly (Job 31:12; Ps 52:5)
Pual passive: to be pulled up by the roots, be destroyed (Job 31:8)
